notes: Aggregates current Form W-2G box 4 federal-withholding findings into the family subtotal that Form 1040 line 25c reports (i1040gi-2025 l.2587-2592: 'any federal income tax withheld on your Form(s) W-2G ... shown in box 4'). Guards its own collect: the family must be confirmed closed, so an unconfirmed family is SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED and never a partial sum. Closed-empty publishes zero only through current literal-true closure. A statement with no box 4 amount recorded is not a member and adds nothing. Never reads box 1, state or local withholding.
